ratified_by: USER (explicit instruction: '코인 신선도 종목별 판정 채택')
amends: Application scope of P9_06_UPBIT_CRYPTO_PAPER_V1 (config/upbit_realtime_freshness_policy_ratified.json) for INTERNAL_VIRTUAL_PAPER. Thresholds unchanged: CRYPTO provider age 20s, transport delay 3s.

rule.per_market_freshness: Each market's realtime freshness is judged independently with the ratified thresholds.
rule.action_cap: A STALE/MISSING/UNKNOWN market caps only that market's action state (no new PAPER entry for it). Other FRESH markets are evaluated normally.
rule.exit_path: A held position in a STALE market gets no PAPER exit execution until fresh data returns; the runtime records HOLD with reason per market and raises an alert if a held position stays stale beyond 30 minutes (engineering alert budget, not a policy threshold).
rule.aggregate_status: The aggregate realtime overall_status continues to be recorded for display/telemetry but no longer blocks all candidates.
rule.regime_axes: Unchanged: regime axes do not use realtime ticker freshness.

cio_companion_decision.decision: Apply the already-ratified Upbit liquidity floor (24h traded value >= KRW 5,000,000,000) to the realtime subscription/candidate set; markets below it are not subscribed as PAPER candidates (e.g. LINK ~3.2B, SHIB ~4.0B at 2026-09-13). Evaluated daily from the universe capture; fail-closed if turnover unknown.

not_adopted: Option A (use ticker message timestamp as provider time) and option C (orderbook liveness) are NOT ratified here.
